workflow: Kentucky New Hire Reporting bulk web-file upload
observed_sequence: Initial web-file preview failed: 8 total records, 7 recognized as previously submitted duplicates, 1 rejected. The rejection was tied to an Employer City / Employer Optional City field containing invalid characters.
A corrected preview approximately three minutes later succeeded in preview mode: 8 total records, 1 acceptable, 7 previously submitted duplicates, 0 rejected.
The file was then submitted successfully: 1 acceptable, 7 previously submitted duplicates, 0 rejected, and 0 duplicate records within the uploaded file itself.
source_filename_observation: The uploaded spreadsheet filename included a 2025-05-15 date while the portal upload occurred on 2026-05-15.
interpretation: The portal supports an explicit preview/correction/submission workflow and reports different duplicate classes.
The first failure was corrected before final submission, demonstrating a recoverable validation loop rather than an unreconciled failed filing.
The high previously-submitted duplicate ratio may indicate a reused reporting file, deliberately cumulative file, stale export, or another process reason; the email alone cannot determine which.
Filename/date mismatch should be validated before using filename dates as authoritative reporting-period metadata.
automation_opportunities: Generate new-hire submission files from only unreported hires when the source system supports reliable submitted-state tracking.
Preflight for duplicate candidates and show a review summary before submission.
Record portal preview/completion results in an audit log and reconcile accepted, duplicate and rejected counts.
privacy: No employee names, identifiers, hire dates or other row-level new-hire data are stored in this record.
